unlimited_fair_use.value: Regular unlimited plans: full-speed allocation per 24-hour period (local midnight to midnight), then reduced to 1 Mbps for the rest of that period; full speed resumes at next reset. Ultra plan: 30 GB full-speed per monthly billing cycle, then 1 Mbps. Saily may also apply traffic shaping/throttling during high demand or in specific locations, and may reduce speeds, remove allowances or disconnect eSIM for misuse. Prohibited: commercial use/resale/groups, bulk M2M, continuous streaming replacing fixed-line, excessive tethering.
unlimited_fair_use.note: ToS says the daily full-speed allocation is 3 GB OR 5 GB depending on destination country. Marketing pages (Japan, Europe, unlimited page) state 5 GB/day then 1 Mbps. Verify per-country allocation before claiming 5 GB universally.

value.details: eSIM is data-only: ToS says 'Voice calls, SMS and MMS cannot be made or received through the eSIM itself.' Separate optional virtual phone numbers exist but 'can be used for inbound messages only'; calls not currently supported.

value.conditions: Japan page: 'Hotspot: Available'. Pay & Fly page: share eSIM data with other devices. Europe page: hotspot availability 'depends on operator'. Help center claims hotspot works 'even on unlimited packages'.

hotspot.note: Conditions vary by destination/operator. Other sources: https://yesim.app/regions/europe-esim/ ; https://help.yesim.tech/what-makes-yesim-different-from-other-esim-providers/ ; https://yesim.app/pay-and-fly-esim/. Terms of Service do not address hotspot.

unlimited_fair_use.value: Yesim states it 'itself does not enforce a Fair Usage Policy', but partner providers may apply their own FUP; if limits are exceeded 'the operator might reduce the network speed'. No numeric thresholds published on the policy page; no overage charges. Destination pages say speed is throttled after daily usage limits are reached.
unlimited_fair_use.note: Destination pages (https://yesim.app/country/japan/, https://yesim.app/regions/europe-esim/) reference operator Fair Usage Policy / daily limits. ToS also say excessive data use, 'determined at YESIM's sole discretion', is abuse of usage privileges (https://yesim.app/terms-of-service/). Secondary sources (esim-urlaub.de, hypermobile.eu, thetraveler.org; not verified against official pages) claim ~5 GB/day or 50 GB caps on some unlimited plans; NOT confirmed by official pages, so not recorded as fact.

value.details: Pay & Fly: 'Top up anytime, auto top-up available'. Help center: 'you can buy additional data at any time from our app or website'. Destination pages (Japan, Europe) say 'Balance top-up' is 'Available automatically if the subscription is active' (Japan page also says 'Not available' for standard plans).

topup.note: Contradictory wording on destination pages; top-up appears to depend on plan type. Additional source: https://help.yesim.tech/how-do-i-purchase-a-yesim-data-plan/ ; https://yesim.app/country/japan/

refund_policy.value: A refund can be requested within 30 calendar days of purchase only if the plan has not been activated, used or expired; used data is not refunded, refunds of EUR 10 or less are issued as Ycoins, and requests are processed within 15 business days.
refund_policy.note: Technical-issue refunds require notification 'strictly within 1 hour of the issue occurring'.

validity_min_days.note: 'From 1 to 365 days, depending on the selected plan'. Pay & Fly wallet balance 'never expires'.

validity_max_days.note: Same Europe wording at https://yesim.app/regions/europe-esim/ (activation required within 180 days of purchase there).

device_support.value: eSIM-capable, carrier-unlocked device. iPhone XR through iPhone 17 series (not offered for China mainland iPhones); Samsung Galaxy S20+, Pixel 3+, and various Motorola, OnePlus, Sony, Xiaomi models. Laptops/PCs not supported.

network_partners_japan.note: Page does not state which of these a given plan actually uses; operator depends on plan/provider.

(another Circles subsidiary). The about page (https://www.jetpacglobal.com/aboutus/) describes Circles as parent. value.details: Data roaming only, no SMS. Voice calling is a separate add-on pack (from USD 1.99 for 5 minutes; voice packs for 50+ countries per homepage). Japan page: dual-SIM, keeps your original number.

value.conditions: Page says 'Hotspot Sharing - Share your internet freely, no data limits, no restrictions.' The Japan page also says hotspot sharing with no restrictions.

Separately, the T&Cs contain a general Fair Usage Policy covering abuse (spam, violating operator rules, etc.), with no numeric cap.
unlimited_fair_use.note: Extracted via a page summarizer: the 3 GB/24h then 1 Mbps wording appears on the Japan and Europe pages, but it is not certain whether it applies only to the Unlimited pack or to all packs. Verify manually before publishing. The Global page markets 'Unlimited GB' and 'unlimited hotspot' without stating a cap in the fetched text. Secondary source for the same figures: none checked. T&Cs FUP: https://content.jetpacglobal.com/policy/JetpacT&Cs.pdf

value.details: Page says users can 'top up on the go' and 'extend your eSIM with the Jetpac website or app'.

refund_policy.value: Once an eSIM is installed it is considered used and not refundable, except that a refund or replacement can be requested within 30 days of purchase if the eSIM cannot be installed/used due to a technical problem that support cannot fix (not for incompatible phones); a separate 'Moneyback Guarantee' clause promises up to 100% refund for incompatible device or inability to connect to a local network, claimable from purchase until 15 days after validity expiry, after support fails to fix it.
refund_policy.note: Two clauses in the T&Cs overlap (30 days vs up to 15 days after validity expiry); the Moneyback clause says 'Notwithstanding anything to the contrary'. No refund for unused data after validity expires. Read directly from the T&Cs PDF text.

validity_min_days.note: Japan page lists 1, 4, 7 or 30 day validity. Other destinations may differ.

validity_max_days.note: Global page lists 365, 180, 30 and 4 days (e.g. 50GB for 365 days). Unused purchased plans remain installable/valid for 3 months from purchase per homepage and Japan page.
